purpose: Teach: にわかに/あっし/ふふふ/しだいに/ともなう/おさめ/割り切っ/ちょくちょく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、にわかに小テストやるって先生言ってたぞ
lines.en: Riku, your teacher said there's a pop quiz.
lines.style: Light, conspiratorial heads-up. Quick delivery. Almost amused at the warning she's delivering. Eye-roll tone without the actual roll.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、時代劇真似して「あっし」って言うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't start talking like a samurai drama again, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, fast comeback. Mild exasperation mixed with affection. The tone of someone used to being needled and giving it right back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふふふって不気味な笑いするな
lines.en: You've got that creepy little laugh going. Stop it.
lines.style: Mock-accusation, playful. Slightly higher energy than before. Not genuinely bothered — enjoying the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しだいに成績上がってんな、桜
lines.en: Your grades are actually going up, you know.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Genuine observation underneath the teasing. Slight warmth in the voice — noticing something real about him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、塾の延長にともなう疲れ、見えるぞ
lines.en: But I can see the cram school wearing on you.
lines.style: Softer tone. The compliment lands, but now she's checking in. Concerned but not hovering. The way you notice someone without calling attention to it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノート、ちゃんとカバンにおさめろよ、桜
lines.en: Make sure you actually put your notebook in your bag, alright?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. Small gesture of care disguised as mild criticism. Not maternal — just looking out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、結果は割り切ってつぎ頑張れ
lines.en: Let the results go. Just do better next time.
lines.style: Straightforward encouragement. No extra softness, no false cheer. Steady and direct — what you need to hear when you're disappointed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちょくちょく俺ん家来んな、桜
lines.en: Stop showing up at my place all the time, though.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate close. The contradiction lands — she's been checking on him all conversation but now she's pretending to be annoyed. Small smile underneath.
